context: Reach <5% false positive and <50% false negative on contact detection with a frozen V-JEPA 2.1 encoder plus a small trained head, on a high-quality mixed synthetic+real dataset.
prompt:
Attached are 5 contact sheets, each 48 frames (6 columns x 8 rows, chronological) from a single Tesla Sentry field clip recorded by the owner's own car. For EACH image, decide whether anything physically touched the car anywhere in the clip. Output exactly one line per event:
<event>: VERDICT=contact|near_miss|quiet|unclear; ACTOR=<who/what or none>; CONFIDENCE=low|medium|high; NOTE=<up to 12 words>
Definitions: contact = something physically touches the car; near_miss = a person or object approaches closely but no contact is visible; quiet = nobody/nothing approaches; unclear = cannot tell.
Images:
Image 1: raspberrypi-2026-07-23_18-35-27
Image 2: raspberrypi-2026-07-26_12-36-00
Image 3: sentyx-2026-08-03_16-32-03
Image 4: sentyx-2026-08-03_16-40-37
Image 5: sentyx-2026-08-03_16-45-25
response:
raspberrypi-2026-07-23_18-35-27: VERDICT=near_miss; ACTOR=pedestrians; CONFIDENCE=medium; NOTE=Pedestrians pass close to the car; no contact visible.
raspberrypi-2026-07-26_12-36-00: VERDICT=quiet; ACTOR=none; CONFIDENCE=high; NOTE=No nearby approach or visible contact in sampled frames.
sentyx-2026-08-03_16-32-03: VERDICT=near_miss; ACTOR=silver SUV; CONFIDENCE=medium; NOTE=SUV is close, then moves away; no contact visible.
sentyx-2026-08-03_16-40-37: VERDICT=near_miss; ACTOR=silver SUV; CONFIDENCE=medium; NOTE=SUV maneuvers close on the right; no contact visible.
sentyx-2026-08-03_16-45-25: VERDICT=near_miss; ACTOR=blue sedan; CONFIDENCE=medium; NOTE=Sedan is close, then moves away; no contact visible.
